name: Aerosol Insect Repellent
description: Guidelines for traveling with aerosol insect repellent in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Insect repellent aerosols must be 3.4 oz or less in carry-ons. In checked bags, aerosols are allowed but must have cap locks to prevent accidental release.
conditions: Checked aerosols are limited to 70 oz total per passenger, and no single container can exceed 18 oz.

faq.question: Is aerosol insect repellent allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Aerosol Insect Repellent is restricted in carry-on luggage. Insect repellent aerosols must be 3.4 oz or less in carry-ons. In checked bags, aerosols are allowed but must have cap locks to prevent accidental release.

faq.question: Can you pack aerosol insect repellent in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Aerosol Insect Repellent is allowed in checked bags.
